cited.quote: To provide quality reading materials viz. books and periodicals in the public libraries.

rationale: C1 is a policy note listing quality reading materials as a library objective; no extract shows any official step on transparent book procurement for libraries. C3/C4 concern law college librarian service rules, C2 and C5 are unrelated.
No extract mentions removal of Aagaya Thamarai or Seemai Karuvelam from water bodies. C1 and C4 cover channel desilting and water resources generally, C2, C3 and C5 are about agriculture schemes.

No extract concerns allotting houses to holders of identity cards issued under the earlier housing scheme. C1/C4 are health insurance identity cards, C2 house building advance for servants, C3 urban employment job cards, C5 RTI officers.

cited.quote: This Government will modernize the 34 existing bus stands and provide modern integrated bus stands in major cities.
Construction of modern Bus Stands, improvement of existing Bus stands to modern. standards, Rejuvenation of water bodies

rationale: C1 is a budget statement of intent to modernise bus stands. C3 is a GO for a broader urban infrastructure scheme listing bus stand improvement as a suggested work, with no women-specific toilets, shower stalls, changing rooms or nursing stations. No dedicated step.

cited.quote: To encourage greater work participation by women, working womens’ hostels will be established in every district.

rationale: C3, the Governor's address, states an intention to establish working women's hostels in every district; no GO, sanction or construction step is shown. C1, C2, C4, C5 concern other hostels or subjects.
No extract concerns genetic modification technology or GM trials. C1/C3 are IT policy note, C2 environment budget items, C4 TNAU projects, C5 BharatNet.
No extract concerns commissions for riverfront beautification of Cauvery, Vaigai or Thamirabarani. C1-C3 discuss desilting and water resources, C4 a road DPR, C5 a commemorative pillar.
No extract mentions speciality hospitals for beedi workers. C1, C3, C4 are insurance network hospital lists, C2 general health budget, C5 health worker contracts.

cited.quote: 193 Agricultural Machinery Custom Hiring Centres will be established and run through the Farmers, Rural Youth, Entrepreneurs, Registered Farmers' Societies

rationale: C2 is a budget plan for custom hiring centres including through farmers' societies, a related activity; C4 revalidates SMAM funds generally. No extract shows a bank guarantee for societies to buy the specified tractors, planters and harvesters.

cited.quote: a total sum of Rs.303.66 crore has been provided for fishing ban period relief assistance

rationale: C1 is a budget provision for fishing ban relief without stating any increase to Rs 8000; a provision alone is not operationalisation. No GO raising the relief amount appears in C2-C5.
No extract concerns an annual government folk arts festival. C1/C3 are school education and library activities, C2 agriculture budget, C4 crop insurance, C5 DISHA nodal officer.

cited.quote: advise the Government of Sri Lanka to ensure that Eelam Tamils have equal civil and political rights

rationale: C1, the Governor's address, states the government will urge the Union on Eelam Tamils' rights; it is a statement of intent, not a resolution or letter, and does not mention an appeal to the United Nations. C2-C5 unrelated.

cited.quote: As part of the Tamil Nadu River Conservation Project, the Pollution Control Board will establish permanent water quality monitoring stations

rationale: C2 is a budget statement mentioning the River Conservation Project, but only planned water quality monitoring stations; no GO or official step for river cleaning to stop solid waste discharge is shown. C1, C3-C5 unrelated.
No extract mentions formulating a State Education Policy. C1/C2 are general school education policy note content, C3 higher education audit, C4 medical PG prospectus, C5 TNAU grants.
No extract concerns declaring cement, steel, bricks, sand or wood as essential items or selling them at fair prices. C4 declares medical items essential, a different object; C1-C3 and C5 unrelated.

No extract mentions spoken English coaching or an MoU with the British Council or similar institutions. C1-C5 cover learning loss measures, education budget, Covid orphan support and a commission on professional admissions.

cited.quote: Accessible Division Reception, ramps, handrails, braille signage, tactile tiles, renovation in toilets, lifts (23), Re-flooring.

rationale: C1 is a GO (2021-10-01) releasing Accessible India Campaign funds for ramps and toilet renovation for persons with disabilities in public buildings (colleges, a public library). Hospitals and bus stops are not covered, so only part of the commitment. C2-C5 are general schemes.

cited.quote: good quality drinking water will be supplied to all the 79,395 habitations in the State.

rationale: C3 is a budget statement of intent on rural drinking water; C1/C5 release Finance Commission grants partly earmarked for drinking water, a broader activity. No extract shows a step to replace old damaged pipes.
No extract concerns appointment or pay of Anganwadi or Midday Meal workers. C1/C2 are urban employment scheme guidelines, C3/C5 lockdown orders, C4 disaster management staff pay.

cited.quote: This Government will also urge the Union Government to increase the permissible man days from 100 to 150

rationale: C2 is a budget statement that the government will urge the Union to raise days to 150; no formal step (resolution, letter) or amendment is shown. C1, C3-C5 are routine MGNREGS fund and wage orders.
